messages:
asha_cs: Heads-up — LeafHealth onboarding hit intermittent 401s during SDK init then 429s after quick retries, started ~06:02 PST. Posting logs below and next steps.
ravi_dev: Can you paste SDK version and the exact init pattern they're using?
asha_cs: node-sdk v2.3.1. Init is literally `const client = new Redwood({ apiKey: process.env.LEAF_KEY })` right at app start. Keys are ephemeral from their token service (TTL 30s).
ben_support: 401 -> 429 chain usually means token expired mid-handshake + parallel fanout. Any explicit "token expired" messages in auth logs?
asha_cs: We see `authentication failed` followed by `429: rate_limited`. Snippet:
```
[06:02:01] handshake:start -> 401
[06:02:01.200] handshake:retry -> 401
[06:02:01.450] request:final -> 429 x-rate-limit-reset=15
```
carlos_sre: Do we know their server clock? If their token issuer is ahead/behind, ephemeral TTLs break fast.
asha_cs: They reported ~40s drift on their staging worker nodes (no NTP). That would explain a 30s TTL being considered expired immediately by our auth check.
ravi_dev: Yep — token + 40s skew = immediate 401. Also if the app does concurrent init (6 parallel preflight calls), retries combine into a fanout hitting rate limits.
ben_support: Two things to recommend: (1) sync NTP on their infra, (2) add client-side singleflight/caching for token usage so startup doesn't spawn N concurrent handshakes.
asha_cs: I told them:
  - sync NTP on hosts
  - temporarily increase ephemeral TTL to 90s from token service
  - implement singleflight or init-serialization in the client
Tagging @ravi_dev to confirm if the SDK can provide a helper for singleflight.
ravi_dev: I can add a one-line helper: `client.fromEphemeralToken(tokenProvider)` that memoizes an in-flight token retrieval and does exponential backoff for handshake. I'll open a PR today. Also propose SDK tolerate a 10s clock skew by default when validating ephemeral tokens client-side.
carlos_sre: From infra/security we could also offer a server-side "grace window" flag per account (e.g., accept tokens ±5s) but security wants explicit enable and audit logs.
asha_cs: Customer asked if Redwood can temporarily relax auth verification while they patch NTP. Any ops path for short-term relief?
ben_support: Ops can enable a 24h grace-window for account leafhealth with explicit ack. I'll create ticket CS-4621 and get eng-auth to monitor.
onboard-bot: Ticket CS-4621 created by ben_support and assigned to eng-auth. ETA 8h. :white_check_mark:
ravi_dev: PR #784 opened for singleflight helper: https://git.redwood/infer/sdk/pull/784 — includes example and opt-in TTL tolerance.
asha_cs: Sweet. I'll confirm with the customer tomorrow AM and keep this thread for closure. Root cause summary: clock drift on client + short ephemeral TTL + parallel init fanout -> 401 then 429 cascade. :memo: :thumbsup:
